tool_args.rationale: The target horizon of 22.8 greatly exceeds the observed horizons of 0.16–0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves the consequential ambiguity about adaptation and possible reversal.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify its five coupled parameters or its long-horizon behavior.
More short-horizon resolution would be less informative about slow adaptation at the target horizon.
The short-window pilot does not distinguish these from sink-coupled adaptation.
